title: Experiment selection
titleCn: 学生讨论选择物理实验

paragraphs.text: You will hear three students discussing an experiment they're interested in.
First, you have some time to look at questions twenty-one to twenty-five.
Now listen carefully and answer questions twenty-one to twenty-five.
Oh, hi, Jen and Irene. Are you two heading to class?
Hey, Bill. Yes, we're just walking there now. We're a little bit early, but we wanted to prepare our apparatus for the experiment. Do you want to walk with us?
Yes, sure. It'll be good to catch up. How is everything going with your experiment? Have you decided what your test subject is yet?
It's going really well, and we're conducting the test as laboratory partners. We've decided to test the effects of gravitational force on a series of objects with different densities.
It's interesting, but it's a lot of work. I've been planning the experiment for the last two weeks, and I only finished yesterday.
Gosh, Irene, I'm really impressed by how hardworking you are.

paragraphs.label: I
paragraphs.text:
enjoy chemistry so much that it doesn't feel like work. Whenever I have some free time at the weekend, I spend it in the laboratory working on it. It almost feels like a second home to me.

00:01:55,120

How about you, Bill? Who is your laboratory partner?

00:01:59,180

The tutor partnered me with Kim. At first, I was worried because I'd never worked with him before, and I was worried that he wouldn't be very good at laboratory work. But actually, he's very capable.

00:02:10,699

I've noticed that he's always very well-dressed.

00:02:13,800

Yes, he's very stylish, and we share the same tastes in clothes. That doesn't stop him from getting his hands dirty, though. He's a very hard worker and makes a significant contribution, which I'm really grateful for.

00:02:27,720

Ah, it's good that you get on well with your partner. It makes the experiment so much more enjoyable when you work well together.

00:02:35,190

What do you think of the other people in our group?

00:02:37,900

paragraphs.label: A
paragraphs.text:
lot of the boys are really good at maths, which is really helpful with all the calculations we have to do.

00:02:43,820

Irene is good at maths as well, which makes her contribution really useful because she can do all the equations. I take care of all the writing because Irene finds that difficult. We'd probably fail without each other's help.

00:02:57,630

That's true. I'm so glad that we're nearly finished.

00:03:01,740

Only because you finished the data analysis.

00:03:05,060

Oh, Jen, you give me too much credit.

00:03:08,440

I'm so glad that I didn't get partnered with Linda again. Jen and I were grouped with her for our last experiment, and it was a nightmare.

00:03:16,900

Yes. She always submitted her work on time for the group work, but she never had her phone on her, so it was impossible for anyone to keep in touch with her and vice versa.

00:03:28,020

Her attitude was pretty annoying, but in all fairness, she was a very hard worker because she realized the amount of work needed to get a high score.

00:03:36,100

Jen is such a hard worker. In fact, she has been invited to work on the professor's personal project.

00:03:43,040

Wow, that's amazing. Well done. Why were you picked?

00:03:47,120

paragraphs.label: I
paragraphs.text:
thought he would pick one of the students that he's closer to, but he told me he was impressed with me because I always complete reading the assignments in time for class.

00:03:57,880

paragraphs.label: I
paragraphs.text:
bet you'll be really popular among the other students when they find out. They'll all want to hear about the project.

00:04:07,260

Before you hear the rest of the conversation, you have some time to look at questions twenty-six to thirty.

00:04:27,409

Now listen and answer questions twenty-six to thirty.

00:04:46,820

You should give everyone tasks so that they have the opportunity to participate.

00:04:51,420

That's a really good idea, actually. Will you help me decide who to assign each task to?

00:04:57,540

Of course. Now, let's see. Well, as Irene finds writing difficult, perhaps it would be useful for her to practice that by doing the bibliography.

00:05:07,240

paragraphs.label: I
paragraphs.text:
think the bibliography is a bit long for me. I think I'd be better suited to the methodology.

00:05:13,520

Yes, that makes sense. Bill, you've told us that Kim is a hard worker, so I think he should be tasked with the conclusions as there is quite a lot of effort involved.

00:05:26,160

Okay. Sure. I know that Kyle hasn't been feeling well, so he should take care of the abstract and the acknowledgment because there is very little work to be done for those tasks.

00:05:36,180

Jen, do you want to review some of the literature? It's a lot of work, but I know that you really enjoy writing, so I'm confident that you'll do a good job.

00:05:46,100

Sure. Sounds great.

00:05:48,100

Right. So that leaves the bibliography and the discussion to assign. I think that Linda will struggle with the amount of work involved in the referencing, so perhaps I should take care of that task, and she can do the other one.

00:06:02,260

That's great, guys. Thanks for your help. I'll tell the tutor when he arrives.

00:06:10,060

That is the end of section three. You now have half a minute to check your answers.
